answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a public work history before it can trade. New identities start on a narrow ridge of low limits, earning wider access only as completed jobs accumulate. Peers who vouch for a newcomer share the slash if it cheats, so fake accounts echo the same cost back to their creator. A sybil farm must therefore fund, age, and defend every identity separately, while honest agents keep a long horizon of reusable reputation that no fresh clone can copy for free.
